messages:
incidentbot: ALERT: pagerduty/escalation-policy-2 fired for service 'hosted-inference-eu' — urgency: high. Incident ID: INC-20260315-8421. Primary on-call Sam notified.
PagerDuty: page fired to Sam (mobile). Escalation: after 120s -> Dina (secondary), 300s -> Manager Charlie.
Sam: ack'd. on call, looking. :eyes:
Sam: seeing a spike in 5xxs from the EU edge (~3:14 UTC). Putting runbook here.
Elaine: can you paste the error pattern? customer slack already pinged support.
Sam: logs show repeated: 
```
2026-03-15T03:13:57Z inference: request_id=abc123 model=gpt-large status=503 upstream_error=connection_reset
2026-03-15T03:14:02Z inference: request_id=abc124 model=gpt-large status=502 upstream_error=timeout
```
Sam: looks like host pool eu-rt-1 saturated, autoscaler not triggering.
Matt: I'm getting the same metric alerts — queue length > 400, p95 latency > 2s. Frontend returning 503s.
Dina: I didn't get the first page (out of office). I'm online now, switching to secondary.
incidentbot: Escalation timer expired: Manager Charlie paged (phone).
Charlie: I'm up. linking to bridge in 2m. Do we need immediate mitigation or is this recoverable by scale-up?
Sam: attempted scale up via infra autoscaler, it failed with this error: 
```
Error: quotaExceeded for GPU allocation in region eu-west-1
Resource: gpu.v100
```
Sam: seems we're bumping account-level GPU quota. Could be a cloud quota throttle.
Elaine: customer impact? which tenants affected?
Sam: preliminary — all hosted-inference-eu tenants on gpt-large routing. Customer impact: degraded generation calls, some timeouts. Not yet billing-impacting but UX broken.
Matt: applying short-term mitigation: switch traffic for gpt-large in eu to fallback model gpt-medium in next 30s for public-facing routes. Will keep embeddings and internal evals intact.
Dina: please put that behind a canary for 5% first. I'll monitor errors and user complaints.
Sam: command run: `rbctl route update --region eu --model gpt-large --fallback gpt-medium --canary 0.05`
Sam: output: `started canary re-route job job-7854. estimated time 45s`
Charlie: good. Notify SRE infra to request emergency quota increase while we stabilize. @Elaine do you want me to wake cloud-ops?
Elaine: yes please, escalate quota increase to cloud-ops pager and open support ticket. Add logs and billing account id.
Matt: can we also drain the hung hosts to free KV caches? command: `infra drain-host eu-rt-1-07 && infra replace eu-rt-1-07`
Sam: drain started. host reports long-lived KV sessions closed.
incidentbot: User: Sam acknowledged INC-20260315-8421 at 03:15:10 UTC.
PagerDuty: Incident INC-20260315-8421 escalated to Manager Charlie at 03:17:00 UTC due to secondary delayed ack.
Dina: monitoring: canary 5% shows error rate drop from 18% -> 6% on canary targets. Latency p95 for medium model is higher but stable.
Sam: customer support, please post status: "We are experiencing degraded generation in EU region; we’ve routed a subset of traffic to a fallback model and are requesting increased GPU quota. No data exposure."
Elaine: posted on status page and support ticket created: ST-5992.
Charlie: after canary looks good, bump to 50% and then full. keep devs and infra looped.
Matt: canary bumped to 50%. metrics look ok. opening gradual to 100% now.
Sam: canary -> 100% complete. error rate across region down to 1.2%. latency p95 acceptable.
Dina: cloud-ops responded, quota increase approved with temporary allocation. infra autoscaler resumed and started allocating new instances.
Matt: draining/replace completed for eu-rt-1-07, host terminated and replaced.
Sam: incident update: mitigation applied (traffic routed to gpt-medium fallback) and autoscaler resumed after quota bump. Root cause likely sudden increase in demand + hitting GPU quota ceiling.
Charlie: creating postmortem stub. please add timelines and runbook gaps (quota alerting, autoscaler failure visibility). Assign to Sam and Matt for follow-up.
Sam: adding immediate action items: 1) add quota headroom monitoring and alert 2) test autoscaler failure modes in staging 3) add explicit runbook step to failover to smaller model automatically when quota exhausted.
Dina: ack. I'll follow up on PD escalation timing and ensure secondary on-call receives SMS fallback.
incidentbot: Incident INC-20260315-8421 resolved by Sam at 03:20:10 UTC — mitigation in place, monitoring stable.
Charlie: thanks all. final note: customer outreach for top 5 affected tenants; Sam please draft message. :pray:
